constraints.description: A page with an empty title cannot have its domain present in the title.
constraints.rationale: domain_in_title is inverted: value 1 means the domain is absent from the title. An empty title necessarily lacks the domain, while nonempty titles may or may not contain it.

constraints.description: An external-domain redirect can occur only when at least one total HTTP redirect is present.
constraints.rationale: The dataset defines nb_external_redirection as a subset count of nb_redirection, so a positive external redirect is admissible only with a positive total redirect count; zero external redirects impose no restriction on total redirects.
